title: Helm chart fails when SCC restricts runAsUser
body:
When deploying on OpenShift with restricted SCCs, the Helm chart fails because the gateway pod spec hardcodes runAsUser: 1000.

Reproduction:
1. Install on OpenShift with restricted SCC
2. helm install openshell ./charts/openshell
3. Pod fails with: unable to validate against any security context constraint

Expected: Should use OpenShift-assigned UID range.
